headline_hook: Claude Gets a Design Studio, OpenAI Cracks Erdős, and Trump Reaches for the Brakes
preview_topics: disproving Erdős for less than three lattes

pick_of_the_day.thesis: A 90-day government review window won't slow the frontier labs that already move in quarterly cycles — it will calcify their lead by pricing open-source competitors and startups out of the compliance overhead game.

model_literacy.relevance: Anthropic's SDK now exposes thinking token counts in streaming — a sign that variable inference-time compute is becoming a first-class cost and quality lever. Understanding that a model can 'think harder' on difficult problems (and bill you accordingly) matters as extended thinking moves from lab curiosity to production budget line item.

items.title: Claude Design Arrives: Anthropic Bets Big on Visual Prototyping
items.angle: Anthropic isn't just adding a design tool — it's redefining Claude as a prototyping partner that competes with Figma-copilot workflows, not just chatbots
items.key_fact: 5,784 likes and 179 RTs on the showcase thread — highest engagement of any Claude feature launch this quarter

items.title: Claude Plugs Into Enterprise Compliance and Security Stacks
items.angle: Anthropic tackles the 'we can't govern this like other SaaS' objection head-on with compliance API integrations for IT and security teams
items.key_fact: New compliance API partnerships cover the governance gap that blocked Claude adoption in regulated enterprises

items.title: ChatGPT Moves Into PowerPoint — Native Slide Creation, Not Just Suggestions
items.angle: OpenAI deepens the Office integration play: creating editable .pptx files puts ChatGPT in the daily enterprise workflow loop, not just the creative brainstorming one
items.key_fact: 1,554 likes — signals genuine user demand for AI-native document creation over AI-assisted editing

items.title: Alibaba Drops Qwen3.7-Max, Built Specifically for Coding Agents
items.angle: Alibaba's not just releasing another model — it's explicitly optimizing for agent orchestration and MCP, going head-to-head with Claude and GPT on the autonomous coding use case
items.key_fact: Purpose-built for long-horizon autonomous execution and MCP orchestration

items.title: Tencent Open-Sources Hy-MT2: SOTA Translation Across 33 Languages
items.angle: Fully open-source 7B and 30B translation models that hit SOTA among open-source — if you're paying per-token for translation APIs, your cost calculus just changed
items.key_fact: 7B and 30B-A3B parameter models achieving state-of-the-art across 33 languages

items.title: Claude Code's /usage Command Finally Shows Where Your Tokens Go
items.angle: When skills, agents, and MCP servers all eat from the same token budget, knowing which component costs what changes how you architect your setup
items.key_fact: 3,862 likes — token spend visibility broken down by skills, agents, MCPs, and plugins

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.147: Pinned Sessions Survive Idle, /code-review Lands
items.angle: Pinned background sessions that auto-restart on updates solve the context-loss problem that made long-running agent workflows fragile
items.key_fact: /simplify renamed to /code-review with effort levels and inline GitHub commenting

items.title: Anthropic Python SDK Exposes Thinking Token Counts in Streaming
items.angle: If you're running extended thinking in production, you can now monitor thinking token spend per streaming response — critical for cost budgeting
items.key_fact: v0.104.0 adds beta estimated thinking token counts in streaming deltas

items.title: Google Antigravity Gets 30+ Life Science Database Integrations
items.angle: Researchers who previously needed separate tools for each database can now query across 30+ life science datasets from a single agent interface
items.key_fact: 30+ major life science databases integrated into Google's Antigravity platform

items.title: Trump's Proposed 90-Day AI Review Window Would Reshape the Release Race
items.angle: A mandatory government review before model releases doesn't just add delay — it restructures competitive dynamics around who can absorb compliance costs and who gets priced out
items.key_fact: OpenAI and Anthropic reportedly pledging cooperation; open-source and international competitors face the biggest disruption

items.title: How Security Teams Are Actually Using Opus: Threat Detection to Incident Response
items.angle: Real case studies move the cybersecurity AI conversation from 'can it work' to 'here's the deployment pattern' — threat detection, vuln analysis, and incident response
items.key_fact: Multiple partner case studies covering production security workflows with Opus

items.title: Disproving Erdős Cost Less Energy Than Three Almond Milk Lattes
items.angle: Mollick's resource accounting reframes the 'AI compute is too expensive' narrative — 0.6–6.3 kWh to crack an 80-year conjecture is remarkably cheap for the magnitude of the result
items.key_fact: 0.6–6.3 kWh of electricity and 3–31 liters of water to disprove a central conjecture in discrete geometry

items.title: Daytona Hits 850K Daily Sandbox Runs as the Default Agent Infrastructure Layer
items.angle: 74% month-over-month growth signals that coding agents need a dedicated compute layer, and Daytona is winning that race by default

items.title: OpenAI's Model Disproves an 80-Year-Old Erdős Conjecture in Discrete Geometry
items.angle: Not a benchmark win — an actual mathematical contribution that changes a field. The full technical write-up reveals what the model did and what human mathematicians couldn't
items.key_fact: Disproved a central conjecture in discrete geometry that stood for 80 years; 634 likes, 437 RTs

items.title: Mosaic Pushes the Pareto Frontier of ML Weather Forecasting
items.angle: Matching the best deterministic forecasters while providing calibrated uncertainty — in operational meteorology, knowing how confident you should be matters as much as the prediction itself
items.key_fact: Probabilistic model achieves deterministic-matching accuracy with calibrated uncertainty estimates

items.title: 40K Stars: A Repo of Leaked System Prompts from Every Major AI Lab
items.angle: Whether you see it as a security concern or a masterclass, reading how Opus 4.7, ChatGPT 5.5, and Gemini 3.5 are actually prompted reveals production prompt engineering that no tutorial teaches
items.key_fact: 40,549 likes and 6,743 RTs; covers Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6, ChatGPT 5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, and more

items.title: Datasette Agent: Simon Willison Ships AI-Powered Database Exploration
items.angle: An AI agent that autonomously explores, queries, and analyzes unfamiliar databases — practical for anyone who inherits a dataset and needs to make sense of it fast
items.key_fact: Combines Datasette with an autonomous agent for database exploration and analysis

items.title: physics-intern: A Simple Harness That Doubles Gemini's Physics Scores
items.angle: Pushing Gemini 3.1 Pro from 17.7% to 31% on physics problems with structured prompting shows how much performance is still left on the table in evaluation methodology
items.key_fact: 17.7% → 31% accuracy improvement through structured evaluation prompting alone
